name: ballast
description: Ballast doesn't make the ship faster. It stops it going over. Agent skills that encode when NOT to do something. Pure markdown, zero executable surface, 100% self-authored.

plugins.name: career-forge
plugins.description: Read a job description for what it actually requires, then build a CV and cover letter that only claim what you can prove. Requirement/responsibility separation, hard-gate screening, evidence-mapped scoring, LaTeX CV tailoring with ATS verification, AI-tell removal, and application pre-fill that never clicks Submit.

plugins.name: ship-safe
plugins.description: Two gates that run before something becomes irreversible: vet any third-party skill, plugin or package before installing it, and sweep a project for secrets and weaknesses before it goes public.

plugins.name: deep-work
plugins.description: Working discipline for tasks too big to hold in your head. A seven-phase protocol for heavy builds, a five-perspective decision council, and a session-close routine that stops your agent relearning the same thing every session.
